title: Making a 3d chess rpg (online multiplayer and single player).
author: Vickie184
selftext:
I'm making a browser-based 3D chess rpg (online multiplayer and single-player vs an engine) that's going to grow into a full RPG you can play through. It's all set in a world I'm building called Funkatron. At it's worst, its an online 3d chess game that runs in your browser. At most, its all that and also a way to adventure around a world and IP I've been working on for many years, long before the AI boom.  

Each playable army is its own faction. The Brangus Legion, The Goob Gobs, the Orcs of Mon Ghey Ku, and the Falconeers (I'll be adding more sets you can ulock through achievements). The chess part is easy enough, and nothing new. The IP of Funkatron and its depth and breadth are what keeps me going. The world and lore is very much in the vein of Space Balls and Monty Python mixed with some brutalism like Berserk. 

I use AI like a pair programmer; it's fast for the grindy stuff (save systems, UI plumbing, untangling Three.js shader errors). It can't see what it's making, so anything visual; lighting, bloom, shadows; I have to be the eyes for, screenshotting results back over and over. And if I don't keep a hand on the architecture it sprawls into spaghetti fast. The mechanical work is AI. The judgment, aesthetic, tone and direction is all me.

Where things stand: the chess is done. Real rules, checkmate, castling, en passant, promotion, clocks, AI opponent, online play; I could sit down and play a full game right now. What I'm building now is the world itself: a map of places you can travel to and play matches at, each one its own 3D scene, with the RPG story threading through them.

I make a lot of strange things that are all connected to Funkatron. I sell nothing, so I'm not shilling when I say check out my site if you want to see more crazy stuff. 

\- TC Poole

comments.body: What's the rpg part of this?

replies.author: Vickie184
replies.body:
The idea is that you have to travel around the grand map of Funkatron (not seen in the video) to find and defeat various chess masters. Very simple, linear story line. I have this grand world that I've been building for forever and this is a fun way for me to make a chess game inside that world. This screen shot is a very very very tiny part of the map.
